reasoning: As of March 6, 2026, with 25 days remaining until March 31, I need to assess if Russia has already struck NATO territory or will do so. Throughout the Ukraine conflict, Russian drones/missiles have occasionally entered NATO airspace (Poland, Romania, Baltic states) but typically as navigation errors, not intentional strikes. Russia has strong incentives to avoid direct NATO confrontation due to Article 5 implications. The specific criteria exclude intercepted missiles and debris. While tensions remain high, an intentional Russian strike on NATO territory would be a massive escalation Russia has consistently avoided. No credible reports of qualifying strikes have occurred.
